title: EXPLORING PROSOCIAL IRRATIONALITY FOR LLM AGENTS: A SOCIAL COGNITION VIEW

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating classic social science experiments using the CogMir framework to measure specific psychological and cognitive biases (Herd Effect, Authority Effect, Ben Franklin Effect, Rumor Chain Effect, Gambler's Fallacy, Confirmation Bias, and Halo Effect) through Multi-Human-Agent interactions, simulated roles, and controlled Q&A prompts.
